name: Raidmax AM1204 Digital Display ARGB CPU Air Cooler
shortDescription: Raidmax AM1204 Digital Display ARGB CPU Air Cooler (Real-Time Temperature Top Screen / 120mm PWM ARGB Silent Fan / 4 Direct-Touch Copper Heat Pipes / 200W TDP Cooling Capacity / Hydraulic Bearing / Broad Intel & AMD
descriptionHtml:
Raidmax AM1204 Digital Display ARGB CPU Air Cooler (Real-Time Temperature Top Screen / 120mm PWM ARGB Silent Fan / 4 Direct-Touch Copper Heat Pipes / 200W TDP Cooling Capacity / Hydraulic Bearing / Broad Intel & AMD Socket Support / 1 Year Warranty)

Keep your processor cool while monitoring performance in real-time with the Raidmax AM1204 Digital Display ARGB CPU Air Cooler, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Warranty. Featuring a sleek top cover with an integrated digital temperature display and vivid ARGB lighting, this thermal solution gives you instant visibility over your system's heat levels. Equipped with four direct-contact copper heat pipes, dense aluminum cooling fins, and a high-performance 120mm PWM ARGB fan delivering up to 200W TDP dissipation capacity, it balances whisper-quiet operation with exceptional cooling efficiency for modern gaming and workstation builds.
